text: APPROVE. The `try/catch` was the last statement in the loop body, so the old `continue` was a no-op and the new empty catch behaves identically (totals read before an `IOException` are still kept via `ref`). Moving the nested `foreach`, `if/else if` and `&&` chains out of `GatherLcov` brings its complexity well under 15, and nothing in the diff should introduce a new warning. I couldn't build it here, so the build condition rests on reading the diff alone.
